subject: 2550M (February 2007) page 1 item 4, the fourth (branch-code) group of the TIN comb chain: the printed box x 180.24-213.12, y 118.80-134.40 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source bir2550m.pdf sha256 9fb4101ace8c781436dac85df138a8fb9790775291affe2dada030c490d0d2b6. BIR's own field key for it is frm2550m:txtBranchCode. The cell id p1c13 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch.
what: The whole TIN strip — four groups plus the three separator boxes between them — keeps the same outer span 66-213.12 pt (147.12pt). Separator widths are unchanged (they only move). The remaining 132.96pt is split equally across 14 digit cells (3+3+3+5) by left(i)=round(i*width/14, 2). p1c127 left 66 width 28.49 (3 x 9.5, 9.49, 9.5); p1c9 left 99.29 width 28.49 (3 x 9.5, 9.5, 9.49); p1c11 left 132.34 width 28.49 (3 x 9.5, 9.5, 9.49); p1c13 left 165.63 width 47.49 (5 x 9.5, 9.5, 9.5, 9.49, 9.5). A white knockout covers that same outer rectangle so the official 3- or 4-cell artwork does not show through the new even cells. Each digit group keeps ONE outer 0.72pt frame; interior slot dividers are short bottom hairs (~33% of slot height), matching how the official sheet draws a charbox tick (2550M item-1 month v172 is 0.72×4.32pt in a 13.20pt box), not a full-height wall on every digit. Separator boxes keep their dedicated SVG fill and a 0.72pt black frame, and stay non-tabbable. The branch group p1c13 is five locked cells showing 00000 (each input value="0" readonly), because the official artwork already pre-prints 000 in that box: the sheet declares the head office and the corrected form must not invite a filer to type over BIR's own printed constant. First/last writing-surface insets are not re-applied: even cell width across the strip is the layout rule. Branch pitch 9.5.
reason: BIR's February-2007 artwork for 2550M is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. Measured from the pinned PDF, the branch box prints exactly two internal ticks, at x 191.28 and x 202.08, each 3.12pt tall at the foot of the box and 0.72pt wide -- three compartments -- and BIR pre-prints '000' in them as three vector bezier outlines at x 182.64-187.92, 193.44-198.96 and 203.76-208.56. BIR's own eBIRForms client, whose runtime this repository has harvested, declares that same field with max_length 5. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 2007' from 2007 ink, which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug. Filing safety: a branch code is what tells the Bureau WHICH establishment a VAT declaration belongs to. A filer whose branch code has four or five digits cannot enter it on today's form at all, so the return files against branch 000 -- the head office -- and the branch that made the sales files nothing. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3 (2550M, 2551M 2002, 2553 1999), one prints 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten are not measurable by that method. 2550M is not the only form in this class; it is the one corrected here, and the others each need their own record.
authority: BIR eBIRForms HTA runtime declaration (harvested), regulation not identified in-repo. rules/forms/2550m-v2007/fields.json declares field_key frm2550m:txtBranchCode with constraints.max_length = 5, confidence "high", source_refs ["xml-editable-v1#field:frm2550m:txtBranchCode", "official-hta-runtime#control:L409"]; the same file declares frm2550m:txtTIN1 / txtTIN2 / txtTIN3 with max_length 3 each (official-hta-runtime#control:L406 / L407 / L408), so the 3-3-3 part of the chain is agreed and only the branch code is not. NO BIR issuance is cited because none could be identified from anything in this checkout; that gap is stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number, and it stays visible until someone supplies the real one.
diverges_from: audit.py comb_slots_match_printed on the 2550M item-4 branch comb -- the corrected document emits five compartments where the pinned artwork prints three, and must keep being reported as an offender of that assertion (failure kind layout-printed-mismatch where the layout carries the change, invalid-emission where only the markup does). audit.py inputs_span_no_printed_divider must gain offenders on the same comb, because five 6.58pt compartments across a box whose printed dividers stand at x 191.28 and 202.08 put a printed divider inside an input. Neither may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, and no tolerance moves for it.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the three printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace` and by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg`, both agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.01pt on the box 180.24-213.12 and the two ticks 191.28 / 202.08), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together.
